reported.evidence: PARTIAL, not the full three-leg check. Observed by the builder on 2026-10-14 in one window: after a reload with a message queued behind a running turn, the queue file (~/.insrc/chat-queue/e49cade17d555e50.sqlite) showed the new extension host pid holding the lease with a fresh heartbeat, the earlier queued message finished, and no failed or not-delivered row from the reload. Not run, deferred by the owner until the repo path bug that blocks multi-window use is fixed: (1) reload mid-turn with the CLI alive across two windows, (2) reload with a message waiting while a second window ticks, (3) close a window with queued messages. The S001 follow tests mapped here are run by the gate and carry the display half of ac3.

the shell is still one nonce'd inline script, with no direct scrollTop write outside the pager, no innerHTML outside the guarded markdown path and no remote origin
opening a 1,000-row session posts session-restored with at most 200 rows, firstIndex at a turn start, total 1,000 and the session's mode; a short session is posted whole with firstIndex 0
ready, new-chat and open-chat post the same windowed session-restored
a ready after older pages were requested posts the latest window again, with the approval head after it
the stored session is unchanged by paging: after restores and page loads the saved transcript equals the original rows
the chat panel run over the file store: a turn's saves append only that turn's rows, a restored session shows the same rows, and a failing save is logged without breaking the turn

host: attach-image and pick-attachments add to the active session's pending list and post attachments-pending; remove-attachment removes one; errors are posted as one sentence and the list is unchanged

host: ready, new-chat and open-chat post each session's own pending list; an unknown or foreign attachment id in remove or open does nothing; open-attachment opens the resolved path of a row's or a pending attachment
host without the attachments seams: the shell has no attach button or chip row and the four messages are ignored
host: an attach-image whose base64 length implies more than the limit is refused without decoding and without calling the store
host: a dismissed dialog posts nothing, and a pick over the limit keeps the first ten and posts one error sentence

host: a submit stores the user's text with the attachments on the row, echoes them on user-row, sends a prompt that ends with the attached-files block of absolute paths, passes readDirs, and clears the pending list
host: a submit with blank text and an attachment runs a turn and names the chat from the attachment; with blank text and none it is a no-op
host: a submit waits for an attachment still being written, and the message carries every chip in order
host: a later turn of a session with an attachment still passes readDirs, a session with none passes none, and a grant re-run keeps it
host: a grant re-run and a selection continuation leave the pending list untouched and attach nothing
host: a submit with blank text and an attachment supersedes queued approvals
host: with the queue, a submit with blank text and an attachment leaves the waiting cards as they are, waits, and runs once they are decided
host: a chat switch while a submit waits drops the submit and keeps the chips on their session, and a second submit runs after the first
chat host: submitExternal on a closed panel opens it, answers queued although the session exists, and the message is run when the webview posts ready, not before

chat host: submitExternal runs the message at once when the webview is ready and nothing is in progress, and queues it behind a running turn, a followed turn and an approval follow-up; waiting messages run one per turn end, in order
chat host: a message waiting behind a running turn is run after it, and a typed message sent meanwhile waits for the running turn, whose output is posted to its end

chat host: submitExternal answers unavailable with no CLI or blank text, drains after Stop and after a chat switch into the session then active, keeps waiting across a second ready while a turn runs, and drops its list on dispose with a warning

chat host: a pane message waits while a permission request is unanswered, rejects none, and is run after the last one is decided: at once when all were denied, after the follow-up turn when one was approved
chat host: a pane message waiting behind a followed turn is run when the follow fails as well as when it ends
chat host: a pane message waiting behind a turn that fails is run when the error is reported

chat host: a run turn begins a presenter turn just before it starts, passes each tool result that is not an error, and ends it once when the run is over, also for a turn that failed, was stopped or was superseded; a message refused before any run begins none; a presenter that throws does not disturb the turn

chat host: a followed turn begins a presenter turn on its first event, not when the follow is asked for, passes its tool results and ends it when the follow ended; a ready message during a run turn begins nothing, and the run turn's end still opens a newly pending document
chat host: a turn followed by a second message still passes its tool results to the presenter, which opens the document it presents, once

chat queue store: enqueue, head, acknowledge and finish keep seq order, acknowledge a message at most once and only with the lease free, delete a done message, turn a stopped one into failed with a resend, and refuse an enqueue with a note at 500 live rows
chat queue store: two processes on one database file acknowledging the same head at the same moment: exactly one succeeds and the message is processing once
schema 2: a fresh queue file is created with the waiting_on column at version 2, and a processing row can be marked waiting
schema upgrade: a version-1 queue file opens as version 2 with its rows kept and waitingOn empty, and a newer file is still refused
markWaiting sets and clears waitingOn on a processing row only
resendFrom: a failed or not-delivered message joins the back with its text and attachments under the given window key; any other state is refused
presenceOf returns the row, and undefined when there is none
markNotDeliveredIfHead marks the head, the next row becomes the head, and a row acknowledged first by another connection is not marked
markNotDeliveredIfHead marks a retrying head whose window closed and the next row becomes the head
takeOver takes a stale lease of another windowKey only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and fails its message, and refuses when holderGone is false, absent or the heartbeat is fresh
takeOver takes a lease of the claim's own windowKey at once when holderGone is true
two connections racing takeOver on one stale lease, exactly one returns true
reclaim rewrites pid and keeps seq and cliPid for the same windowKey, and refuses another windowKey
enqueue and resendFrom at QUEUE_RECORD_BOUND are refused with FULL_NOTE and leave every row

chat queue worker: the window whose message is at the front takes the lease, runs it through the runner with onSpawn recording the CLI, heartbeats the lease while it runs, finishes it and releases the lease; another window's message at the front is left alone; a submit in one window is seen by another within one poll; a finish that fails is retried on the next poll before any new message is taken; dispose releases the lease when the turn's CLI has exited and leaves it when it still runs; onChange fires after this window's own submit and after another window's commit

worker act: cancel removes a waiting message and is refused once the message has started; dismiss and resend refuse rows in the wrong state; resend takes this window's key; a successful act is seen by onChange at once
worker onWaiting: the runner's card report sets and clears waitingOn on the running message, and a busy write is retried on the next tick

worker recovery: a lease left by a window that reloaded (same window key, old pid and its CLI gone) is freed at once, its message fails for resend, and the queued messages behind it run; another window's dead lease waits LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS
worker recovery: a reloaded window reclaims a lease whose CLI lives and does not fail the message
worker recovery: a dead holder and dead CLI of another window is freed only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and the next message runs
worker recovery: a holder that keeps heartbeating past LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS is never taken over
a reclaimed lease is heartbeated while the CLI lives, then finished as detached-ended and released when the CLI exits, and the next message runs
a reclaimed lease lost to another window clears the marker and stops heartbeating
dispose leaves the presence row in place and windowAlive stays true until PRESENCE_GRACE_MS passes
a head whose window stopped refreshing presence and whose pid is dead is marked not-delivered after PRESENCE_GRACE_MS and the next message runs
a head whose window has a fresh presence row or a live pid is never marked; no presence row and a message younger than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS is not marked
dispose-and-recreate a worker with the same windowKey while a second window ticks, the head is not marked not-delivered
a reload slower than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS ends as not-delivered with a resend and no row is lost
a previous-plugin window's dispose deleting its presence row: a head younger than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS is not marked, an older one is marked once
submit at the bound returns ok:false reason full
start waits for the session lease, reports waiting, runs, and releases the lease when the process exits
a start made while another waits for its lease runs after it instead of dropping it
a turn being read when another start is made keeps reporting to its end and clears its cursor
a lease granted after the turn stopped being current is released
a lock failure and a missing adapter are reported through onError
a beforeRun failure is reported, the session saved and the lease released
the cursor is saved on spawn, throttled on progress and cleared before onTerminal
invalidate and a closed panel suppress all sink calls; live names the turn being read
a panel closed while a turn is read is told nothing more
stop cancels the provider turn and stops the live process; idempotent with nothing running
stop and detach drop a turn waiting for its lease
detach leaves a session-file turn running with its cursor saved and stops a pipe turn
stop continues past a failing cancel or process stop
follow skips a running turn, a turn already followed and a turn owned by a live host
follow takes ownership from a dead host, reports every event, clears the cursor and calls onEnd
a failing resume keeps the cursor saved
stop ends a followed turn's process; detach leaves it running
a detached session-file turn is resumed by follow
trySaveSession logs a failing save and never throws
a generator whose cleanup throws when the turn finishes it is not an unhandled rejection
a start made while beforeRun runs waits for that turn; a turn stopped while beforeRun runs starts no CLI
a turn's end with another start waiting saves its cleared cursor and keeps its native session; Stop drops the waiting start
a throwing onTerminal is logged, still finishes the generator and is not a turn error
an aborted follow unwinding late does not drop the next follow's process, so Stop still ends it
a throwing onEvent is reported and the turn's generator is finished
a failing onError report is logged and start never rejects
a failing follow onEvent is logged and the follow still ends the turn
a turn whose output ends without a done or error event ends as an error

turn lifecycle: busy is true while a started turn waits, sets up or is read and while a follow is read; false after the terminal event is handed over, after a follow ends, after stop and detach, and when follow returns without following; a chained turn keeps it true
turn lifecycle: a follow whose resume fails calls its end callback exactly once, and busy is false when it is called
turn lifecycle: busy is false when a turn's error is reported

turn lifecycle: a second start runs after the first ends instead of superseding it, and a start waiting in that chain is dropped by Stop and by detach and never spawns; onSpawn reports the CLI with an exit promise for a live and a followed turn, also after detach
